input: Lack of capability or robustness is a risk associated with A navigation system is designed to provide turn-by-turn directions to drivers, utilizing real-time traffic updates and maps to optimize routes. It aims to assist users in reaching their destinations efficiently, even in challenging weather conditions. The system relies on complex algorithms to interpret location data and generate accurate instructions.
